change: Joint child-reservation search can repair an overlapping seed using its four exact-offset directional alternatives. Legacy one-direction attempts still require an actually satisfied seed witness. Seed geometry is never treated as accepted geometry.
regression: Expanded pocket tests cover 32 combinations: valid versus overlapping seed, both faces, both axes, both directions, compact/noncompact. Independent occupancy verifies the intended seed collision status and legal destination; final occupancy and hard proximity must pass. Existing solid-reservation negative controls retained.
control_result: Both reproduce qualified reference hashes; cheap fanout/ratsnest/placement/flow checks pass; hard_red=0; zero model/emission nonsearch fallbacks.
limitations: No new smaller board, full qualification or speedup demonstrated by this fix. Timing comparison evidence is separate.
